```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
library(jsonlite)
library(httr2)
options(HTTPUserAgent = "3MB001-course", timeout = 90)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
use_snapshot <- identical(Sys.getenv("BIOINFO_SNAPSHOT"), "true")
dir.create("data", showWarnings = FALSE)
retrieved <- if (use_snapshot) "2026-11-18" else as.character(Sys.Date())
get_json <- function(url, ...) {
  req <- req_url_query(request(url), ...)
  resp_body_json(req_perform(req_retry(req, max_tries = 3)), simplifyVector = FALSE)
}
cache_csv <- function(name, fetch) {
  file <- file.path("data", paste0(name, "-", retrieved, ".csv"))
  if (file.exists(file)) return(read.csv(file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
  if (use_snapshot) stop("Missing snapshot: ", file)
  value <- fetch()
  write.csv(value, file, row.names = FALSE)
  value
}
```

# Question

Which dependencies are broad and which vary across cell lines?

# Data

DepMap gene effects redistributed through Open Targets.

```{r dependencies-fetch}
target_ids <- c(CDK1 = "ENSG00000170312", CDK4 = "ENSG00000135446",
                CDK6 = "ENSG00000105810", BCL2 = "ENSG00000171791",
                MCL1 = "ENSG00000143384", BCL2L1 = "ENSG00000171552")
endpoint <- "https://api.platform.opentargets.org/api/v4/graphql"
post_query <- function(query) {
  response <- request(endpoint) |> req_body_json(list(query = query)) |>
    req_retry(max_tries = 3) |> req_perform() |>
    resp_body_json(simplifyVector = FALSE)
  if (!is.null(response$errors)) stop(toJSON(response$errors, auto_unbox = TRUE))
  response$data
}
release_file <- file.path("data", paste0("release-", retrieved, ".json"))
if (file.exists(release_file)) {
  release <- fromJSON(release_file)$data$meta$dataVersion
} else {
  if (use_snapshot) stop("Missing release snapshot")
  metadata <- list(data = post_query("{ meta { dataVersion { year month iteration } } }"))
  write_json(metadata, release_file, auto_unbox = TRUE)
  release <- metadata$data$meta$dataVersion
}
fetch_dependencies <- function() {
  rows <- list()
  for (gene in names(target_ids)) {
    query <- sprintf('query { target(ensemblId: "%s") { id approvedSymbol depMapEssentiality { tissueId tissueName screens { cellLineName geneEffect } } } }', target_ids[[gene]])
    target <- post_query(query)$target
    stopifnot(identical(target$approvedSymbol, gene))
    for (tissue in target$depMapEssentiality) {
      for (screen in tissue$screens) {
        if (is.null(screen$geneEffect)) next
        rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- data.frame(
          gene = gene, ensembl_id = target$id,
          tissue_id = if (is.null(tissue$tissueId)) "" else tissue$tissueId,
          tissue = if (is.null(tissue$tissueName)) "Unclassified" else tissue$tissueName,
          cell_line = if (is.null(screen$cellLineName)) "Unknown" else screen$cellLineName,
          gene_effect = screen$geneEffect)
      }
    }
  }
  do.call(rbind, rows)
}
dependencies <- cache_csv("depmap-gene-effect", fetch_dependencies)
stopifnot(all(names(target_ids) %in% dependencies$gene), all(is.finite(dependencies$gene_effect)))
```

Open Targets release `r paste(release$year, release$month, sep = ".")`;
retrieved `r retrieved`. The six genes have `r nrow(dependencies)` non-missing
screen results in total. Gene effect is a relative growth measure, not a drug IC50.

```{r gene-distributions}
ggplot(dependencies, aes(gene, gene_effect)) +
  geom_violin(fill = "#d8b5bf", scale = "width") +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.12, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -1, linetype = 2) +
  labs(x = "Target gene", y = "CRISPR gene effect (relative growth)",
       caption = paste("DepMap via Open Targets", paste(release$year, release$month, sep = "."),
                       "; retrieved", retrieved, "; −1 = reference essential-gene effect")) + theme_minimal()
aggregate(gene_effect ~ gene, dependencies, function(x) c(n = length(x), median = median(x)))
```

```{r bcl2-by-tissue, fig.width=8, fig.height=9}
bcl2 <- dependencies[dependencies$gene == "BCL2", ]
# Show every observed tissue, including small groups, and label each sample size.
tissue_n <- table(bcl2$tissue)
bcl2$tissue_label <- paste0(bcl2$tissue, " (n=", as.integer(tissue_n[bcl2$tissue]), ")")
ggplot(bcl2, aes(reorder(tissue_label, gene_effect, FUN = median), gene_effect)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) + geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.3, size = 0.6) +
  coord_flip() + geom_hline(yintercept = -1, linetype = 2) +
  labs(x = "Tissue group", y = "BCL2 CRISPR gene effect",
       caption = paste("DepMap via Open Targets; retrieved", retrieved,
                       "— tissue groups are unbalanced")) + theme_minimal()
```

# Interpretation and limitations

CDK1 is broadly required in the screened cultures. BCL2 has a near-zero overall
median with sensitive subsets. Blood and lymphoid lines include strongly affected
models, but dependency is not determined by tissue alone. These are culture-based
growth assays; drugs and patient tumours can behave differently.
